stage: uncropped OSM geography → single global affine → fixed terrain grid → viewport clip only
sourceExtentCaveat: Finite geographic query, not worldwide coverage. Full returned way geometry is retained without the old tile-frame crop.
topologyPolicy: Original way IDs, ordered node IDs, all source vertices, tags, layers, bridge/tunnel and one-way evidence retained. No intersection clustering or connections inferred from crossings. This is not a routing authority.
cropPolicy: No source-geometry crop; render clips only after projection. Stored old graph is unchanged.
holdoutCaveat: Legacy bridge correspondences excluded from this fit, not newly surveyed independent observations. Residuals combine correspondence uncertainty and model error.
